description: Version 1 server-to-client match snapshots and countdown events are implemented; other listed message types remain reserved until their handlers are implemented and integration-tested.
rules: The server validates all state-changing requests.
Clients must reject unsupported protocol versions.
Untrusted client payloads must be validated before use.
Server match snapshots use the match.snapshot envelope and are broadcast after roster and lifecycle changes.
The countdown is informational; the server remains authoritative for the transition into the active phase.
Message types not listed as implemented in the architecture documentation remain reserved for future handlers.
